findings.title: Client-Side Authentication Bypass — Credentials Exposed in JavaScript
findings.description: The login form performs authentication validation entirely in client-side JavaScript. The hardcoded credentials (admin/sup3rsecr3t) are visible in the page source. An attacker can bypass the JS check entirely by sending a direct POST request to index.php, which the server-side PHP code accepts without any server-side credential verification. The flag is revealed upon successful authentication.
